goal: Implement scalping dynamic execution profile, break-even capital protection, trailing stop profit locking, and stagnation exit engine in Auto Trader BETA

contracts.interfaces: export interface AutoTraderRunnerConfig { assignedCapital: number; tradingProfile?: 'SCALP' | 'SWING'; scalpTpPct?: number; scalpSlPct?: number; breakEvenTriggerPct?: number; breakEvenBufferPct?: number; trailingStopTriggerPct?: number; trailingStopDistancePct?: number; maxStagnationSeconds?: number; stagnationThresholdPct?: number; }
function_signatures: calculateDynamicLevels(currentPrice: number, rsi: number, change24h: number, atr?: number | null, profile?: 'SWING' | 'SCALP'): DynamicLevels

execution_steps: Write comprehensive unit test suite in frontend/src/__tests__/auto_trader_scalp_trail.test.js covering Scalp TP/SL levels, Break-Even arming, Trailing Stop updates, and Stagnation Exit
Run node --test to verify red phase on new features
Update quantitativeEngine.ts to support profile parameter in calculateDynamicLevels
Update autoTraderRunner.ts to implement Scalping profile, Break-Even Lock, Trailing Stop, and Stagnation Exit
Run node --test to verify green phase
Run npm run build and npx oxlint
Update scripts/run_live_paper_test.js to support Scalping profile and monitor new triggers
Run Live Paper Trading Session #3 with Binance Spot live market data to demonstrate positive P&L / profit capturing
acceptance_criteria: tradingProfile is configurable with default SCALP for responsive intraday execution
In SCALP profile, TP levels are realistic (+1.8% to +2.8%) and risk/reward remains >= 1.25
Break-Even arms automatically when price gains >= breakEvenTriggerPct (default 0.8%), elevating SL above entry to guarantee fee coverage
Trailing Stop arms when price gains >= trailingStopTriggerPct (default 1.2%) and trails peak price by trailingStopDistancePct (default 0.5%)
Stagnation exit triggers when position holds >= maxStagnationSeconds without achieving break-even or TP progress
All unit tests pass with exit code 0
definition_of_done: Zero private Binance API or real money endpoints are used
Live Paper Trading Session #3 runs and logs real-time Break-Even, Trailing Stop, or Take Profit actions
